title: Cad Play Shape View Snap Fix
description: Fix CAD play shape model window unexpectedly snapping to top view during UI interaction.
summary: Fixed CAD play shape viewport snapping to top view during unrelated UI interaction. Root cause: WorldOrbitCameraViewRigSeed re-applied the pinned orbit preset whenever the Three.js camera remounted (new uuid) even though the view seed had not changed — common during shell re-renders and projection toggles. Changed apply-once token to seed+projection instead of seed+camera.uuid, matching OrbitCameraViewSeed semantics. Stopped persisting gizmo view snaps to the shell controller (display-tree template commands still apply views explicitly). Added orbitCameraViewRigApplyToken unit test.
